QuestInfo.name: Please collect moonlight from the full moon.
QuestInfo.0: In lieu of Moon Festival, Gaga launched a business involving... selling moonlights from the full moon? How the heck is he planning to collect MOONLIGHT? Click on the Event Notifier on the bottom or go talk to Gaga directly.
QuestInfo.1: Gaga handed you an Empty Bottle that you are supposed to carry for 30 minutes with the lid open. It's SUPPOSED to collect nearby moonlights. Was the poor Gaga tricked by someone again? For now, let's just hear him out and hold on to the open bottle for 30 minutes.
QuestInfo.2: After 30 minutes, SOMETHING was collected in the bottle, but you are not sure if it's moonlight. With utter joy, Gaga granted you a buff. I hope the business takes flight this time, Gaga!
